newsitem.title: CHINA: Insurer Lincoln to open third China office.
newsitem.headline: Insurer Lincoln to open third China office.

text.p: U.S. insurer Lincoln National Corp has opened a third representative office in China as part of its campaign to win an operating licence to issue policies, the China Daily Business Weekly said on Sunday.
The new office was opened in the boomtown of Guangzhou in southern Guangdong province, the newspaper said.

Lincoln was seeking to set up a joint venture in Guangzhou or the eastern city of Shanghai to underwrite life and health insurance policies, the newspaper quoted Lincoln National president and chief operating officer Robert Anker as saying.
"The large potential of the Chinese market is favourable to all kinds of activities and would allow a great number of players," it quoted Anker as saying.
Lincoln had invested $53 million in manufacturing and construction projects in China, the newspaper said.
American International Group of the United States and Japan's Tokio Marine and Fire Insurance are the only two foreign insurance companies currently issuing insurance policies in China.
Manulife (International) Ltd, a Hong Kong unit of Manulife Financial has announced it will open an insurance joint venture in Shanghai later this year.
